body: ## Pull request overview > [!NOTE] > Copilot was unable to run its full agentic suite in this review. Fixes WASAPI input device initialization by using the capture endpoint's native mix rate instead of incorrectly applying the configured (render) mix rate with rate adjustment, which is unsupported for capture endpoints. Adds a separate input_mix_rate tracking and exposes it via `get_input_mix_rate()`. **Changes:** - Extracted stream flag/mix-rate decision into a static `get_audio_client_setup()` helper that skips `AUDCLNT_STREAMFLAGS_RATEADJUST` for input endpoints. - Tracks input device mix rate separately and overrides `get_input_mix_rate()`. - Added unit tests covering the new helper for both input and output paths. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | drivers/wasapi/audio_driver_wasapi.h | Declares helper struct/method, input_mix_rate field, override, and test accessor friend. | | drivers/wasapi/audio_driver_wasapi.cpp | Implements the new helper, applies it in device init, tracks/resets input_mix_rate, and implements `get_input_mix_rate()`. | | tests/drivers/test_audio_driver_wasapi.cpp | New unit tests for the audio client setup helper. | --- 💡 Add Copilot custom instructions for smarter, more guided reviews.
